caseName: Consolidation Coal Co. v. Dir., Office of Workers' Comp. Programs
caseNameFull: CONSOLIDATION COAL COMPANY v. DIRECTOR, OFFICE OF WORKERS' COMPENSATION PROGRAMS, DEPARTMENT OF LABOR

opinions.text: Motion of respondent Robert Thompson for Attorney's fees and expenses granted. The Court approves the parties' agreed upon attorney's fees of $14,732.50, and expenses of $1,152.63, to be paid by Consolidation Coal Co.
